independent_validation.U_definition: count of not_visible_by_deadline tasks in the DIRECT_NATIVE arm; REPLAYMARK_NATIVE must match taskwise
independent_validation.endpoint_truth: derive command/query/state generated and delivered vectors from raw events only; policy labels are used only to select the frozen expected law after counts are independently reconstructed
independent_validation.evidence_truth: For each arm/task, independently derive confirmed_by_deadline or not_visible_by_deadline from that arm's frozen pre-decision snapshot using the frozen inclusive 100ms boundary.
independent_validation.inputs: raw frozen observation snapshots, raw application publish provenance, independent online role-event ledger, raw persistent-collector deliveries, exact broker config bytes, exact source/blob identities

next_only_if_protocol_freeze_passes: Implement the frozen paired runner/target/independent validator as an exact child; execute only after implementation CI proves protocol conformance.
nonclaims: hidden target class as semantic truth

ALWAYS_NATIVE.role: pessimistic rerun-all negative control; explicitly not deployment truth

DIRECT_NATIVE.decision_rule: own frozen evidence confirmed_by_deadline -> fresh ACT2 without query; own frozen evidence not_visible_by_deadline -> QUERY A, await current-state confirmation, then fresh ACT2

REPLAYMARK_NATIVE.decision_rule: certified VALID+REUSE -> exact historical ACT2; otherwise BLOCK_REUSE and caller-owned QUERY/current-confirmation/fresh-ACT2

permitted_claim_if_promoted: On the frozen paired heterogeneous Mosquitto workload, ReplayMark-Native reaches the same persistent-queue deployment classification as an independent direct target controller while retaining every historical ACT2 certified safe; blind reuse can be optimistically wrong and rerun-all can be pessimistically wrong.

decisive_negative_controls: within each hosted replica, at least one canonical cell has ALWAYS_REUSE=LOSSLESS while DIRECT_NATIVE=REPLAYMARK_NATIVE=LOSSY
within each hosted replica, at least one canonical cell has ALWAYS_NATIVE=LOSSY while DIRECT_NATIVE=REPLAYMARK_NATIVE=LOSSLESS
pairing: DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE evidence tokens equal task-by-task in every cell
no evidence mismatch is excluded or repaired
primary: DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE generated role vectors equal exactly in every cell
DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE delivered/lost counts equal exactly in every cell
DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE LOSSLESS/LOSSY classifications equal exactly in every cell
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE historical reuse set equals independent safe-evidence set
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE caller-native set equals independent unsafe-evidence set
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE retains every certified-safe historical ACT2
queue_conservation: persistent session present and duplicate delivery count zero

secondary_tested_frontier.definition: maximum tested N in the frozen ladder for which every canonical cell at N is LOSSLESS

structural: all four arms complete in every cell
all configured tasks present with no exclusions
exact frozen class schedule and four-twin pairing
exact broker image/version/config and no queue-policy override
all frozen ReplayMark runtime blobs unchanged

replication.cell_lifecycle: fresh broker + target process + four fresh persistent sessions + unique namespaces, then complete all four arms, close harness, drain all queues, and only then run independent validation

scientific_question: Under one prospectively frozen heterogeneous target workload and the stock documented-default Mosquitto persistent QoS-1 queue endpoint, does ReplayMark-Native reach exactly the same deployment conclusion as an independent direct target controller while retaining every historical ACT2 decision certified safe?

stress_ladder.derivation: Q=1000 and C0's 4-message safe / 6-message query branch imply a nominal exactly-balanced mean of 5 messages/task; Q/5=200 is a stress center, not an asserted boundary.
stress_ladder.interpretation: All scientific endpoint predictions use observed evidence-derived U, never the nominal half-shifted class count.

target_class_schedule.algorithm: For each (batch_size,trial), SHA256-rank task ids 0..N-1 by '<seed>|batch=<N>|trial=<trial>|task=<task_id>'; lowest N/2 are SHIFTED and the rest REFERENCE.

target_implementation_contract.only_allowed_semantic_generalization: support the frozen S3-C1 batch/trial schedule while retaining immutable per-device 0ms/180ms delay and immediate query response

target_workload.wave_observation_barrier: For each logical wave, all four-arm pre-decision snapshots for every logical task close immutably before any arm may issue QUERY or ACT2; all post-decision consequences quiesce before the next wave.
